name: provider-template-example
description: Reference plugin for plugin-contributed provider templates — adds an OpenAI-compatible gateway entry to the provider picker. Pure data: no code, no runtime, no side effects. The template carries a baseURL + model list only; you still supply your own API key in Settings.
author: CodePilot

providerTemplates.description: An OpenAI-compatible gateway, contributed by a plugin. Swap the baseURL/models for a real endpoint.
